dummy.numeric: log1p (columns in log_inputs) then median imputation with a missing indicator per column that has missing values in the training fold
dummy.route_median: distance_km_max: missing values filled with the median of customer_state x primary_seller_state, else customer_state, else the global median, learned in the training fold, plus distance_km_max_missing (G-27)
dummy.duplicates: encoded columns identical to an earlier column in the training fold are dropped (4.3 rule; e.g. the missing indicators of fields that are always missing together)
dummy.target: log1p(lead_days), predictions expm1, scored in days (G-36)
dummy.fitted: inside each training fold in s06-s08, never in s04
